interface.longDescription: Read-only Amazon Neptune access for AI agents over MCP: list schemas, describe tables, sample rows, and run guarded queries. Set $CONNECTPAK_NEPTUNE_URL in your environment before starting Codex. Writes are rejected by a parser guard and by the engine's own read-only mode; every query has a timeout and a row cap.
